t: The Essentials 18" industrial floor fan is designed for effective ventilation and cooling in large rooms or trade environments. This powerful floor fan features a 3-speed rotary switch and an adjustable tilt function, allowing precise control over directional airflow up to 145.2 litres per second. Ideal for workshops, garages, and large commercial spaces. The 120W motor operates on a standard 220-240V supply, providing consistent air movement to maintain comfortable working conditions or assist with drying tasks.
